title: Government consultation on lengthening the Indefinite Leave to Remain qualifying period closed
body: A UK government consultation on lengthening the general qualifying period for Indefinite Leave to Remain from 5 years to 10 years closed on 12 February 2026. The change has been reported as expected to take effect around autumn 2026, but as of this record's last review it had not yet been made law; the current 5-year general qualifying period, and the shorter periods available on accelerated routes, remained in force. Anyone currently planning toward settlement on the 5-year timeline should treat this as an active, moving situation rather than a settled fact, and check the current position before relying on either the old or the proposed figure.
